installed_release_recording.scope: One navigation pass across nine pages with available scroll areas; mostly overview otherwise. No settings changes, network tests, hardware controls or complete interaction matrix.
limitations: Cold initializations and subsequent updates are mixed in a single exploratory recording.
SwiftUI cause graph and 100-us CPU sampling add overhead; sampled CPU is not normal CPU utilization.
Most installed release project frames are stripped. No reliable per-function attribution for their addresses.
Body durations can nest; total is not mutually exclusive CPU work.
No overall FPS, hitch ratio, presentation cadence, energy or leak conclusion. The changed code has not been installed.

measurement_limits: A single baseline/after pair with 120 draw repeats and 10 complete analysis repeats, not randomized multi-run statistics.
Heatmap prepare_ms counts one layout preparation, not every SwiftUI parent update. It is excluded from redraw median.
Heatmap array/tooltip isolation adds retained prepared data; no measured memory reduction.
KDE regrouping changes floating point summation order within the checked tolerance; full analysis timing did not show a meaningful speedup.
